name: 97038 · Molalla, OR
findings: ZIP 97038 (Molalla) has 31 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97038 (Molalla) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 97038 (Molalla) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 50% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.
